UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Google user profile metadata for Multi Calculator cloud sync.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

CloudNote.title: CloudNote
CloudNote.description: User-authored notepad document synced across devices and reinstalls.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

isPinned.description: Whether the note is pinned at the top of the list.

clientCreatedAtMillis.description: Original note creation epoch milliseconds preserved across sync.

clientUpdatedAtMillis.description: Last modification epoch milliseconds used for conflict resolution.

CloudHistoryEntry.title: CloudHistoryEntry
CloudHistoryEntry.description: Arbitrary-precision calculation history entry synced across devices and reinstalls.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

result.description: Exact or configured-precision calculation result string.

calculatorMode.description: Calculator mode used when evaluating the expression.

angleUnit.description: Trigonometric angle unit used when evaluating.

clientCreatedAtMillis.description: Original calculation epoch milliseconds preserved across sync.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Per-user synced notepad documents keyed by note UUID.

/users/{userId}/history/{historyId}.description: Per-user synced calculation history documents keyed by entry UUID.
